limitations: One observation per lane, not a stable performance estimate.
Preparation and preflight overlap with local mutation QA; workflow and provider times are separate from total time.
A source diff hash identifies the retained local candidate; the full candidate diff is not redistributed in this artifact.
No production database, deployment, or company source. This real Maven case is not the separate opt-in Maven/Gradle fixture suite.
Generated context is smaller without shortening approved plans; no general latency benefit has been demonstrated.
